result.topic_en: Hilbert defines Riemann surfaces $R_z$ indexed by numbers z of the second number class through limits of surfaces with finitely many sheets, and states properties: containment, existence for every z, mappability onto a part of the plane, and a number z for which this planar part consists only of points.
